name: Domus
description: Domus is the home hub that remembers what you forget. Connect it to Claude and manage your home by chatting: look up what filter your furnace takes, check which appliance warranties are about to lapse, log a repair you just did, add a new appliance with its model, serial, and warranty, or open a document like an inspection report and review it. Domus keeps a living record of every property you own — appliances and equipment, documents, maintenance schedules, and air filters — captured by snapping a photo of a data plate and synced across web, iOS, and Android. This connector gives Claude both read and write access: browse and open documents, list and update assets, log and schedule maintenance, mark filters changed, and flag warranties expiring soon. Free to start; your data is always exportable and deletable, and you can revoke access anytime in Domus → AI Assistants.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Domus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Domus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.getdomus.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Domus MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domus lists 15 MCP tools, including complete_task, create_asset, create_maintenance_task, get_asset, get_document, get_home, list_assets, list_documents, list_filters, list_homes, list_maintenance, and log_service.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Domus?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Domus in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Domus requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Domus is developed by Domus. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
